description: Look up one paper by DOI or OpenAlex id and return its identity (title, year, venue) plus every retraction record the graph holds for it, each with its source and source tier: A is an official registry, B an authoritative index, C an aggregator. Use it to check whether a paper is retracted and which sources assert it; use retraction_propagation to judge whether that retraction reaches a specific citing paper. Free in the public tier. Returns: paper identity and statuses[] with source, source_tier, is_retracted, retraction_date and source_uri; abstention_reason when the paper is not in the snapshot.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, e.g. 10.1016/S0140-6736(97)11096-0. Provide exactly one of doi or paper_id.

paper_id.description: OpenAlex work id, e.g. W2117847125. Provide exactly one of doi or paper_id.

name: integrity_paper_status
